title: Capsicum: Practical Capabilities for UNIX
summary: Robert Watson presents the Capsicum paper at USENIX Security 2010, describing practical capability-based sandboxing for UNIX. The paper won Best Student Paper.
why: Referenced as the authoritative talk on Capsicum, including comparisons of how little code it takes to sandbox programs versus SELinux.

quote.text: to sandbox chromium with capsicum it took 100 LOC, to sandbox chromium with SELinux it took 200 LOC
